requirement: DanceFlow policy: an engine run covers exactly one dance; a run covering none or several dances fails closed (COMP_ENGINE_UNSPECIFIED_CASE, multi_dance_unsupported, X-6), so DanceFlow calculates no combined championship placement and never infers an overall winner.
enforcement_point: Both Studio engines refuse danceIds.length != 1 (X-6). Verified scope: engine refusal and absence of aggregate fields in engine output. NOT verified here: the database schema and readers (no aggregate column/reader was searched exhaustively); per-dance result storage for multi-dance rounds is not claimed.

tests.name: a single-dance run carries no overall, combined or aggregate field

X-6 none or several dances → unspecified (also for a round that is not danced)
